description: Experimental beta: subscription swipe commit travel is reduced from 80dp/30% to 64dp/22% of the card width for more ergonomic one-try hiding. The 20dp activation threshold, 1.75:1 horizontal intent, vertical-scroll rejection, reversal cancellation, persistent local fallback, and verified native Hide action remain unchanged. Only YouTube 20.40.45 is supported; pagination, account/incognito switching, and live/upcoming behavior still need broader validation.
